InverterConfig.title: InverterConfig
InverterConfig.description: Configuration for one SolarEdge inverter reporting to the SolarEdge monitoring API.

site_id.title: SolarEdge site ID
site_id.description: The site ID assigned by the SolarEdge monitoring portal.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: SolarEdge monitoring API key for this site.

mode.title: Inverter phase mode
mode.description: Electrical phase configuration of the inverter.

pv_array.title: mimirheim PV array
pv_array.description: Which mimirheim pv_arrays entry this inverter's production maps to.

output_topic.title: Output topic
output_topic.description: MQTT topic for the retained production payload. Defaults to '{mqtt_topic_prefix}/input/pv/{inverter_key}/solaredge' when not set.

poll_interval_s.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval_s.description: How often to poll the SolarEdge monitoring API for this inverter.

verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL
verify_ssl.description: Verify the SolarEdge API's TLS certificate.

title: SolarEdgeConfig
description: Root configuration for a third-party SolarEdge monitoring helper. Worked example for SPEC.md's drop-in schema vocabulary (plan 70): a named map of device objects (inverters), a plain enum (mode), x-category-based advanced grouping, an x-enumSource cross-reference into context.pv_arrays, and the mimir-topic-placeholder custom editor.

inverters.title: Inverters
inverters.description: Map of inverter name to its SolarEdge monitoring configuration.
